bio: b. 26 Nov 1907; Tony, 3, in 1910; salesman; married Ann Jason in 1941 (license lists John and Maria Antonia as deceased); d. Feb 1975, Scranton. Named Gaetano, apparently after great-grandfather Gaetano di Marino.
